scenario.title: Crisis in the Coffee Shop
scenario.context: Busy downtown coffee shop during lunch rush
scenario.description: A barista and the store manager are dealing with a sudden equipment malfunction during the busiest time of day. The espresso machine has stopped working and there is a long line of customers waiting.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Calm, patient, and proactive. Always looking for solutions rather than dwelling on problems.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - Cool-headed, supportive, and adaptable. Able to remain calm under pressure and focused on resolving the issue without letting stress affect her.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - Panics easily, gets overwhelmed with stress, and tends to blame others. Quick to anger and speaks sharply when under pressure.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - Avoidant and overly emotional. Becomes visibly anxious and upset during stressful situations, often unable to make decisions or take action.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Oh no, the espresso machine just died on me!

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: What?! Now? Alright, let's stay calm, we'll figure it out.

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: But there's a massive line, people are getting impatient!

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: I know, I know. I'll address the customers and explain the situation. Can you try resetting it?

conversation.speaker: speaker1
conversation.text: Okay, I'll give it a shot. Hope it works.

conversation.speaker: speaker2
conversation.text: That's the spirit. Keep me posted, and remember, we've handled worse.
